javax.microedition.theme
Class SkinException

java.lang.Object
  java.lang.Throwable
      java.lang.Exception
          javax.microedition.theme.ThemeException
              javax.microedition.theme.SkinException
Direct Known Subclasses:
SkinNotFoundException
public class SkinException
extends ThemeException

Thrown by SkinManager methods or updateApplicationElement in Skin if a skin-related operation fails. Specific subclasses of this exception class must be thrown in appropriate situations, as documented for the appropriate methods.
